title: Which option survives?
claim: An option is the answer when it meets every requirement and ranks first on the qualifier.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions that you ask of each option. First: does it break a stated requirement? Yes removes it. Second: does it solve a different problem? Yes removes it. Third: does another working option rank higher on the qualifier? Yes removes it. An option that passes all three questions is the answer.
